description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for claims to property of intestate in Dompe D/S Division and other properties
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically the registration of title for intestate properties under the Registration of Title Act. It contains notices calling for claims to properties of deceased individuals, detailed land descriptions including parcel numbers, extents, and registration details. The content focuses on land title settlement procedures and property ownership transfers, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily deals with land registration and property ownership matters.
